headline_finding.what: our own Gumroad storefront shows only 9 of 76 products, and the set was actively harmful
headline_finding.consequence: a cold visitor arriving on the marketplace surface was shown our worst $150 listing and never shown our best one
headline_finding.fix_applied: renamed owtmpe to '[Unavailable] AI Workflow QA & Stress Test - ...' so the storefront card itself carries the warning. Its description already said withdrawn, but the card did not show that.
headline_finding.note: Gumroad first rejected 'WITHDRAWN — DO NOT BUY —' as promotional spam; a neutral '[Unavailable] ' prefix was accepted.
headline_finding.verified: name changed; price unchanged ($150); file count unchanged (0); description unchanged; storefront HTML now shows the [Unavailable] prefix
headline_finding.still_needs_dashboard: storefront curation (which 9 products appear) has NO API - GET /storefront, /user/products and /profile all return 404

nostr.evidence: nostr_replies_gf17.json shows eose=true replies=0 for every post; zero posts record a non-zero response. Posting more here is volume with no evidence of reach.

telegraph.value: still the best free channel because it needs no identity and links out to products, but it has not produced a buyer

bing_indexnow.value: real and accepted; Bing is the only engine that has our URLs

channel_reality_check.google: NOT submitted - requires a Google identity via Search Console. IndexNow does not include Google.
channel_reality_check.social_forums: none usable - Reddit, Quora and StackOverflow return 403 or require an account; no account exists on HN, IndieHackers, ProductHunt or LinkedIn
channel_reality_check.gumroad_marketplace_search: could not be verified programmatically - Gumroad pages are client-rendered and /discover returns 404 to an unauthenticated fetch

seo_infrastructure_verified_sound.noindex_which: history.html, login.html, status.html - correct, these are account pages
seo_infrastructure_verified_sound.robots_txt: Allow: / for all agents, points at the live sitemap
seo_infrastructure_verified_sound.external_inbound_links: present - Telegraph articles link to customer_site pages, giving crawlers a real path
seo_infrastructure_verified_sound.conclusion: nothing technical is suppressing organic reach. The constraint is that Google has never been told about the site.

storefront_defects_needing_dashboard: Storefront shows 9 arbitrary products; the $155 flagship is not among them. Fix: in Gumroad dashboard, curate the storefront to lead with /l/iaiyt, /l/fgruzn and /l/uldlwa.
Storefront meta description reads 'Get the latest products and updates from aek grafat on Gumroad.' - the display name appears garbled. Fix: correct the account display name in Gumroad settings.
Archive /l/owtmpe entirely - no API can unpublish or delete.
Delete /l/dxfwlu, the $1 API test object - no API can delete it.
what_was_not_done_and_why: No new Nostr posts: 20 posts produced 0 responses, so more posting is unjustified volume.
No self-affiliate linking or any attempt to manufacture a sale.
No scraping of Google to check indexing - that violates their terms and would not be reliable evidence.
No fake traffic, no paid ads, no paid API credits.

measurement.qualified_visits: UNKNOWN - the page-view beacon still 404s on the GitHub Pages host
measurement.basis: authoritative Gumroad API across all 77 products, all time

honest_conclusion: Every identity-free lever has now been tested with real evidence. Distribution exists and is verified, but none of the available channels has produced a visitor or a buyer. The remaining levers all require the founder's identity: Search Console for Google, a storefront curation in the Gumroad dashboard, and one community account. That is the actual bottleneck, not code.
